summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K reporting its agreement to acquire 100% of a portion of the Argonauta Field ring-fence from Shell, ONGC, and Brava in Brazil's Campos Basin. The total consideration is R$ 700 million plus US$ 150 million, payable in three installments: R$ 100 million at closing, R$ 600 million by January 15, 2027 or closing, and US$ 150 million two years post-closing. Upon completion, Petrobras will hold 98.11% of the Jubarte Shared Reservoir. The deal requires ANP and CADE approvals. Watch for regulatory clearance timeline and any competitive objections.
